pages.text: Your guide to everything in the mod! The heart of it is this: what you build inside your soul changes what you can do outside of it.

Grow a farm in there and every meal goes further. Build an armoury and your sword bites harder.$(p)There are no blueprints to copy - build what you think a farm looks like, and it is judged on its own merits. See $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/rooms)Soul Rooms$(/l).
